module: Flowgraph node "Rally Route Data" (category repeat_instant, tag rally). Reads the rally manager (gameplay_rally.getRallyManager()) and publishes in nextRoutePointPos (vec3) the recovery destination position (rm:getRecoveryDestinationPos()). Also copies flow to the output.
notes: The pin description talks about the "next route point ahead of the vehicle" but the code returns getRecoveryDestinationPos().

work.desc: Every frame: updates nextRoutePointPos from the rally manager and copies the flow.
